# EXECUTE IMMEDIATE rejects multiple INTO rows, outer variables and nested control statements.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/procedural-language.md

DECLARE x INT64; EXECUTE IMMEDIATE "SELECT * FROM UNNEST([1, 2])" INTO x
=> error:

DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT 1; EXECUTE IMMEDIATE "SELECT x"
=> error:

EXECUTE IMMEDIATE "EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT 1'"
=> error:

EXECUTE IMMEDIATE "IF TRUE THEN SELECT 1; END IF"
=> error:

# Answers collected from BigQuery with bqanswers: BigQuery rejects BEGIN...END blocks too, although
# the reference says a query statement may contain one.
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE "BEGIN SELECT 1; END"
=> error contains: SQL created by EXECUTE IMMEDIATE contains unsupported statement type: BeginEndBlock

# Answers collected from BigQuery with bqanswers: BigQuery rejects DECLARE too.
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE "DECLARE y INT64 DEFAULT 2"
=> error contains: SQL created by EXECUTE IMMEDIATE contains unsupported statement type: VariableDeclaration
